content: No tree becomes deeply rooted and sturdy unless many a harsh wind assails it.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
explanation: A tree cultivated inside a greenhouse grows tall and lush, but its wood is soft and its root system is shallow; the moment it is moved outside, a moderate breeze topples it. The alpine cedar growing on the cliff face is constantly wrenched by gales, which forces its roots deep into the granite. Adversity anchors you.
practicalInsight: When life shakes your branches today, thank the wind for forcing your roots to grip the bedrock of faith and virtue.
reflectionPrompt: What severe trials have you survived that resulted in you being far more sturdy than you were five years ago?
